query:
SELECT cards.id, cards.name, dataSources.sourceIdentifier 
FROM cards 
INNER JOIN dataSources ON dataSources.cardId = cards.id 
WHERE dataSources.sourceIdentifier IS NOT NULL AND dataSources.source = 'snkrdunk'
LIMIT 5;
